info.title: BELLATRIX Agent CLI
info.description: Model-free automation CLI for AI coding agents. Drives desktop (WinAppDriver), web (Selenium) and mobile (Appium) automation one JSON command at a time, and scaffolds BELLATRIX skills and subagents for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Devin, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Antigravity CLI, Kiro CLI and OpenCode (C#, Java, TypeScript).

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: bellatrix 3.2.0 - model-free UI automation CLI (output is always JSON).

commands.name: help
commands.description: Describe the commands (bellatrix help [<command> | <domain> [<verb>]], or <command> --help). --json for machine-readable output.

commands.name: sessions
commands.description:
List the persisted sessions of every domain, or prune stale ones.
--list                         Report the sessions (the default).
--prune                        Delete sessions idle longer than the keep-alive TTL and stop their local web drivers.

options.name: --prune
options.description: Delete sessions idle longer than the keep-alive TTL and stop their local web drivers.

options.name: --agent
options.description: AI agent(s) to scaffold for, comma-separated (windsurf = devin, agy = antigravity).Default: the agents already scaffolded, else the one detected from repo markers. (one of: claude|copilot|cursor|devin|codex|gemini|antigravity|kiro|opencode)

options.name: --language
options.description: BELLATRIX flavor. Default: the recorded language, else detected from build files, else csharp. (one of: csharp|java|typescript)

options.name: --domains
options.description: Domains to scaffold. (default: desktop,web,mobile; one of: desktop|web|mobile)

options.name: --out
options.description: Repository root to scaffold into. (default: current directory)

options.name: --regenerate
options.description: Overwrite files you edited (otherwise they are skipped and reported).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report what would be written; change nothing.

options.name: --template-source
options.description: Render your own template folder (same layout as the built-in templates) instead of the BELLATRIX templates.

options.name: --prefix
options.description: Namespace for --template-source output (skills, agents, fragment, manifests). Default: inferred from the folder.

options.name: --project
options.description: Your BELLATRIX test project file (.csproj, pom.xml, build.gradle, package.json) for every domain, or per domain (desktop=<path>,web=<path>). Default: detected (projects referencing BELLATRIX); recorded in .bellatrix/config.json.

options.description: Delete sessions idle longer than the keep-alive TTL and stop their local web drivers.
